processing: Both user-supplied originals retained byte-for-byte. A separate playback MP3 removes the first 1278900 decoded samples (exactly 29 seconds at 44100 Hz), resets timestamps and encodes the remaining audio using libmp3lame at 192 kbps stereo with a Xing header. The clipped resource starts and loops at its own zero, without seeking 29 seconds into either file. Deployment choices and campaign navigation preserve playback position; volume and battle-entry fade are applied at runtime.
